_comment: Generated by tools/art-manifest/build_manifest.py — do not hand-edit; change the script or the game data and re-run.

style.name: Painterly storybook — soft watercolor/gouache, warm natural light, wonder over grit
style.scene_suffix: painterly storybook illustration, soft watercolor and gouache, warm diffused natural light, visible brush texture, gentle rounded shapes, wondrous and serene, no text, no letters, no watermark
style.icon_suffix: flat game-UI icon, one centered symbol, bold clean silhouette that stays readable at 32 pixels, warm gold #f2d06b with bronze #8a6d3b inner shading on a flat deep-forest-ink #0b1712 background, faint parchment grain, storybook-ornament feel, no text
style.chrome_suffix: flat front-facing game-UI element, perfectly symmetrical and centered, no perspective, hand-painted storybook ornament, bronze #8a6d3b and gold #f2d06b filigree on deep-forest-ink #0b1712, faint parchment grain, crisp edges, no text

style.negative_prompt_flat: text, letters, words, captions, logo, watermark, signature, photorealistic, 3D render, plastic, glossy, neon, lens flare, harsh black shadows, gore, blood, horror, grimdark, oversaturated, cluttered background, deformed anatomy, extra limbs, duplicate subject, cropped subject, perspective, scenery, landscape background, drop shadow
rules: Darkness reads as cold absence of warmth — never gore, never horror.
The island is benevolent by default: creatures look gentle and curious unless the prompt says otherwise.
One shared light: warm, diffused, golden-hour. No neon, no lens flare, no hard black shadows.
No text inside any image. Titles, stats and card text are rendered by the engine / render_cards.py.
Color is never the only carrier of information (asset-pipeline.md): every element also has its own icon and shape.
Proposed art rule (not in data): creature scale reads tier — common small, uncommon mid-sized, rare large.

generator.model: Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image) — in Google Flow or through the Gemini API
generator.references: Attach the batch's style anchor (and the category anchor named in each job's `references`) as reference images on every job. Keep reference sets small — 2 to 4 clean, consistent images; large mismatched sets drift.
generator.resolution: Request 2K for icons and chrome, 4K (API: image_size "4K") for tiles, cards and screens; downscale to each job's target_px on import.
generator.flow: In Google Flow, save each anchor as an Ingredient and reference it from every job in the batch.
generator.seeds: Generate each batch in one session with one seed family; regenerate a job with its neighbours' seed before changing the prompt.

batches.title: Style anchors
batches.purpose: Generate first and approve by eye. Every later job references one of these.

batches.title: UI chrome
batches.purpose: 9-slice frames, buttons and HUD widgets. All UI is currently drawn in code (StyleBoxFlat) — these replace it visually without layout changes.

batches.title: Icon vocabulary
batches.purpose: One icon per glyph the code currently draws as an emoji or Unicode symbol (dock buttons, HUD stats, tile markers, runes).

batches.title: Board
batches.purpose: Hex terrain tiles (pointy-top), face-down tiles, the Sanctum glow, the Guardian-site overlay and the pawn token.

batches.title: Guardian sigils and gates
batches.purpose: One sigil per element plus the Corrupt Gate (max-dark band) and the Guardian Gate (max-light band).

batches.title: Card illustrations
batches.purpose: One art panel per existing card PNG (composited into the card frame by render_cards.py) plus the full-bleed card back.

batches.title: Screen backgrounds
batches.purpose: Menu, character select, board backdrop, winner chronicle, modal texture.

batches.title: Store and ship assets
batches.purpose: App icon, adaptive icon layers, Play Store feature graphic, splash.
